content.comment_body: It seems [company_name] has updated the [article_no] to a new [article_no]. What are the differences between these versions? There appears to be limited documentation available for reference. Additionally, has [product_name] been updated to [version_no]? The Update Center in the help menu no longer functions.
From what I know, the latest model [article_no] supports custom websites created with [product_name] Web Editor software from [company_name]. The previous model [article_no] does not allow this.

There is a delivery release for [product_name] [version_no]. If you have a full version of [product_name], you can download the upgrade to [version_no] from the [company_name] website. Be sure to select the correct version for Windows (32-bit or 64-bit). After downloading, you will have a file named 'Setup.exe.' Run it with administrator rights and follow the prompts.

Thank you, I discovered [version_no] shortly after I posted. However, the web server functionality seems limited; I can connect and see the device, but there’s no ability to make changes. The website indicates that the web editor should be available in [version_no], but I cannot locate it. [url]

It seems you may have overlooked the pages I referenced. The Web Editor is a separate software tool used to create custom web pages for the extended web server available in [product_name] [version_no]. The project you develop with the Web Editor must be transferred to the device using a properly formatted (FAT32, full format) SD card beforehand. The Web Editor can be downloaded from the '[document]' section.
Thank you, and sorry for missing that link earlier.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users encountered confusion regarding the transition between [company_name] hardware versions, the differences in features, and where to find reliable documentation, particularly in relation to web server capabilities and software version upgrades. Challenges accessing updated tools and unclear instructions, especially for deploying web features using [product_name] Web Editor, highlighted documentation and support gaps.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect comprehensive documentation about hardware version changes, straightforward and reliable software update mechanisms, and detailed, accessible guides for enabling new or extended web server functionalities within their devices.
